thread.title: China's Weakness Could Be Positive for the Trade War Says Cramer

author: Katherine Ross
title: China's Weakness Could Be Positive for the Trade War Says Cramer
text:
In his morning column over on Real Money , Jim Cramer weighed in on China's weakness and what it could mean for the trade war.
"[On Monday], we got two figures that were pretty ugly: a guide-down in a world growth forecast from the IMF, 3.5% versus just 3.7% made in October; and a Chinese growth figure for 2018, 6.6%, the worst since 1990," he wrote. "Plus Chinese unemployment went from 4.8% to 4.9% -- in stark contrast to U.S. employment, for certain."
"...The weakness in China improves the prospect of a trade deal -- provided that the Chinese somehow become willing to acknowledge that they steal IP. I bet they are trying to figure out how to show that they do," wrote Cramer.
"The solution is pretty easy: Grant our companies the rights to operate independently of China, be willing to prosecute those who steal, including the execs who run Xiaomi, and then let the telcos offer subsidies for Apple ( AAPL ) phones on par with domestics, and it's a done deal," he continued.
Which other stocks stand to benefit? ( CAT ) and ( HON ) were among Cramer's 16 picks .
Apple is a holding in Jim Cramer's Action Alerts Plus portfolio.
